verdict.rationale: Solid says it is built on TypeScript and JSX, and the tsconfig snippet (`jsx: preserve`, `jsxImportSource: solid-js`) shows its JSX types plug into the standard TypeScript compiler. That implies the normal TypeScript language service can type-check Solid components in an editor. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly documents editor autocompletion, inline type errors, or any dedicated language-service or editor integration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of editor autocompletion and inline diagnostics, any dedicated language-service plugin or editor extension, and hands-on or independent reports of how accurate the editor tooling is.
